name: button
title: Button
description: Triggers an action. Native button with solid, line, ghost and danger variants.
a11y: Native <button>: Enter and Space activate, Tab focuses.
loading sets aria-busy and blocks clicks while keeping the label.
asChild renders a link without losing link semantics.

props.name: variant
props.description: `solid` is the one main action per view. `line` for the rest, `ghost` for inline links, `danger` for destructive.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` (default) or `sm` for dense toolbars and table rows.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner, sets `aria-busy` and ignores clicks. The label stays so the width does not jump.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the child element (a link, a router link) with the button styles instead of a `<button>`.

usage: import {Button} from '@monoline/react';
